newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus sees Nethold 1.7 bln Fr 3-yr op loss.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus sees Nethold 1.7 bln Fr 3-yr op loss.

text.p: French pay television group Canal Plus told financial analysts on Monday that it expected merger partner Nethold to make total losses of 1.7 billion francs over three years before reaching breakeven.

The French group said in a statement issued to analysts and journalists at the meeting that Nethold -- with which it is to have merged by mid-April -- will reach breakeven at the operating level in 1999 in Italy and the Benelux countries and in 2001 in Scandinavia.
The breakeven level for the group as a whole would be at the end of 1999 at the operational level, it said.
The statement also spoke of an "improvement in the Nethold annual result from 1997".
